name: decision-models
description: Ask cheap decision models (Jev, Clef, GPT-6 Luna) typed questions for calibrated yes/no, choice and score answers, alone or as a consensus. Direct API keys or gateways (OpenRouter, Vercel, OpenCode, custom).

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.description: Model Claude and /opinion ask when consensus is off. cheapest: the cheapest configured model (jev, then clef-flash, gpt-6-luna, clef).

consensus.title: Consensus
consensus.description: off: ask only the default model. unanimous: ask every enabled model; an answer counts only if all that answered agree. majority: ask every enabled model; the answer of more than half of those that answered wins.

checkCommits.title: Check commits
checkCommits.description: After Claude makes a git commit, ask the decision models whether each file in it belongs to the commit message. Files they're sure are unrelated (p >= 0.8) are sent back to Claude to split into their own commit. Skips one-file commits; judges up to 30 files, one call each.

triageOutput.title: Triage long output
triageOutput.description: When a Grep, Glob or Bash result has 40 or more lines, ask the decision models which lines matter for your latest prompt, and add the ones they're sure of (p >= 0.8) as a note next to the output. Claude still sees the full output. Judges up to 320 lines, 32 per call; adds a second or two to those tool calls.

catchEarlyStops.title: Catch early stops
catchEarlyStops.description: When Claude ends its turn, ask the decision models whether it stopped partway through your task: said there was more to do, then stopped without asking you anything. If they're sure (p >= 0.8), Claude is told to continue or say plainly that it's done. At most once per turn; one call per turn.

useJev.title: Use Jev
useJev.description: Which provider Jev goes through. auto: TypeSafe directly if its key is set, else the first gateway with a key. off: left out when asking all models (consensus, /opinion-all, cheapest); naming it explicitly still works.

useClef.title: Use Clef
useClef.description: Which provider Clef goes through. auto: Cloudflare directly if its key is set, else the first gateway with a key. off: left out when asking all models (consensus, /opinion-all, cheapest); naming it explicitly still works.

useClefFlash.title: Use Clef-flash
useClefFlash.description: Which provider Clef-flash goes through. auto: Cloudflare directly if its key is set, else the first gateway with a key. off: left out when asking all models (consensus, /opinion-all, cheapest); naming it explicitly still works.

useGpt6Luna.title: Use GPT-6 Luna
useGpt6Luna.description: Which provider GPT-6 Luna goes through. auto: OpenAI directly if its key is set, else the first gateway with a key. off: left out when asking all models (consensus, /opinion-all, cheapest); naming it explicitly still works.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account ID
cloudflareAccountId.description: Masked and kept in your keychain; /decision-models:setup shows only its last 4 characters. Empty: falls back to CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.

cloudflareApiToken.title: Cloudflare API token (Clef, Clef-flash, Jev, GPT-6 Luna)
cloudflareApiToken.description: A Cloudflare API token with Account > Workers AI > Read (an AI Gateway-only token is refused). Clef and Clef-flash run on Workers AI; Jev and GPT-6 Luna run through Cloudflare with no TypeSafe or OpenAI key, billed from AI Gateway Unified billing credits, which must be loaded. Empty: falls back to CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.

cloudflareGatewayId.title: Cloudflare AI Gateway ID
cloudflareGatewayId.description: Send every Cloudflare request (all four models) through this AI Gateway, for logging, caching, rate limits or Unified billing. Same token; adds the cf-aig-gateway-id header. Empty: Cloudflare default routing.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key (Jev, Clef, Clef-flash, GPT-6 Luna)

openrouterSort.title: OpenRouter routing
openrouterSort.description: Which host OpenRouter prefers when several serve a model (Clef-flash has four). default: your OpenRouter account routing. latency: fastest host. price: cheapest host.

vercelApiKey.title: Vercel AI Gateway key (Jev, GPT-6 Luna)

opencodeApiKey.title: OpenCode Zen API key (Jev)
opencodeApiKey.description: Empty: falls back to OPENCODE_API_KEY. OpenCode Zen serves Jev 1.13, text only.

customUrl.title: Custom gateway endpoint URL
customUrl.description: Full URL of another gateway's decision endpoint.

customFormat.title: Custom gateway format
customFormat.description: systemone: the Jev/Clef request shape. openai: the OpenAI Decisions shape.

customModels.title: Custom gateway models
customModels.description: Model names and the gateway's IDs for them, e.g. jev=typesafe/jev,clef=cloudflare/clef.
